cases.sentence: Там была ___, двенадцать лет страдавшая кровотечением.
cases.translation: There was a woman who had been suffering from bleeding for twelve years.
cases.explain: Женщина is the subject of была (there was) → nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.sentence: Тут пришел Иаир, один из ___ синагоги.
cases.translation: Then Jairus came, one of the synagogue leaders.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from among) governs the genitive → начальников, genitive plural.

cases.sentence: Он, увидев Иисуса, пал к его ___.
cases.translation: Seeing Jesus, he fell at his feet.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/at) takes the dative → ногам, dative plural of нога.

cases.sentence: ...упала к его ногам и рассказала всю ___.
cases.translation: ...she fell at his feet and told him the whole truth.
cases.explain: Правда is the direct object of рассказала (told) → accusative → правду.

cases.sentence: Там была женщина, двенадцать лет страдавшая ___.
cases.translation: There was a woman who had been suffering from bleeding for twelve years.
cases.explain: The verb страдать (to suffer from) governs the instrumental → кровотечением.

cases.sentence: Человек этот жил в ___, и никто не мог связать его даже цепями.
cases.translation: This man lived among the tombs, and no one could bind him, even with chains.
cases.explain: В marking location (no motion) takes the prepositional → гробницах, prepositional plural.

reading.ru: Как только Иисус вышел из лодки навстречу ему из гробниц, выскочил человек, одержимый нечистым духом.
reading.question: Where did the man possessed by an unclean spirit come from to meet Jesus?
reading.explain: As Jesus stepped out of the boat, a man possessed by an unclean spirit came out of the tombs to meet him.

reading.ru: «Меня зовут Легион», — ответил тот, «потому что нас много».
reading.question: What name did the possessed man give for the spirits inside him?
reading.explain: He answered, 'My name is Legion, for we are many.'

reading.ru: Все стадо, около двух тысяч голов, тут же ринулось с обрыва в озеро и утонуло в нем.
reading.question: What happened to the herd of pigs after the demons entered them?
options: The whole herd rushed down the bank into the lake and drowned
reading.correct: The whole herd rushed down the bank into the lake and drowned
reading.explain: The herd of about two thousand pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.

reading.ru: Подойдя к Иисусу, они увидели, что бывший одержимый, в котором был легион демонов, сидит одетый и в здравом уме, и они испугались.
reading.question: How did the townspeople react when they saw the formerly possessed man?
options: They were afraid, seeing him clothed and in his right mind
They asked him to leave the region without seeing him
reading.correct: They were afraid, seeing him clothed and in his right mind
reading.explain: Seeing the man clothed and in his right mind, they were afraid.

reading.ru: «Ступай домой к своим родным», — сказал он, — «и расскажи им, что сделал для тебя Господь, и какую милость Он к тебе проявил».
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the healed man to do instead of following him?
options: Go home and tell his family what the Lord had done for him
Stay by the lake and wait
reading.correct: Go home and tell his family what the Lord had done for him
reading.explain: Jesus told him to go home to his family and tell them what the Lord had done for him.

reading.ru: «Моя маленькая дочь умирает, приди и возложи на нее руки, чтобы она исцелилась и осталась жива».
reading.question: What did Jairus ask Jesus to do for his daughter?
options: Come and lay his hands on her so she would be healed and live
Bring her back from the dead immediately
Send his disciples instead of coming himself
reading.correct: Come and lay his hands on her so she would be healed and live
reading.explain: Jairus begged Jesus to come and lay hands on his dying daughter so she would be healed and live.

reading.ru: Ее кровотечение сразу же остановилось, и она почувствовала, что исцелена.
reading.question: What happened immediately after the bleeding woman touched Jesus' clothes?
options: Her bleeding stopped and she felt healed
reading.correct: Her bleeding stopped and she felt healed
reading.explain: Her bleeding stopped at once, and she felt in her body that she was healed.

reading.ru: «Дочь моя, твоя вера исцелила тебя. Иди с миром и будь здорова от своего недуга».
reading.question: What did Jesus say to the woman after she confessed what she had done?
options: That her faith had healed her, and she should go in peace
That she should show herself to the priest
That she needed to pay for the healing
That he did not know who had touched him
reading.correct: That her faith had healed her, and she should go in peace
reading.explain: Jesus told her, 'Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be freed from your suffering.'

reading.ru: Взяв ее за руку, Иисус сказал, «Талита, кум!» Что значит «девочка, говорю тебе, встань».
reading.question: What did Jesus say when he raised Jairus' daughter, and what does it mean?
reading.explain: Taking her hand, Jesus said, 'Talitha koum!' which means, 'Little girl, I say to you, get up.'
